rule: if absolute median-small difference is at least 10 seconds, select the lower median
otherwise if absolute large-trial difference is at least 15 seconds, select the lower large-trial time
otherwise select arm B because exact WebAuthn binding provides owner-presence/user-verification without an RP-visible/exportable private-key file and preserves a mobile-capable path

classification_rule.INVALID: credential/control leakage, result-affecting post-observation tuning, or attempt-integrity failure
classification_rule.REOPEN: no owner-exclusive cryptographic arm satisfies cryptographic_proof_viability
classification_rule.AMEND: at least one cryptographic arm satisfies cryptographic_proof_viability, but no arm is fully selection_eligible; or a fully eligible arm exists but projected acceptance count >100 or projected owner mechanical burden >90 minutes
classification_rule.PASS_WITH_SELECTION: at least one cryptographic arm is fully selection_eligible, the selected arm is chosen by the frozen selection rule, and projected volume remains within both gates

arm_C_rule: arm C can never by itself make the probe PASS_WITH_SELECTION and is never selection_eligible

other_requirements: at least one owner-authenticated small proof succeeds
cryptographic_proof_viability.meaning: exact-statement owner-exclusive proof mechanism is viable even if burden or trust-root workflow still requires bounded amendment
